Prepare compositional count data

Source: R/pre_proc.R
data_prep.Rd

Takes a dataset of counts (number of sampled individuals) per bin (length/age/etc) across a range of strata (vars_for_grouping) and expands it for use in the Poisson-multinomial model. Counts are summed within stratum and bin, bins without observations within a stratum are filled with zero counts, and the stratum total n (used as offset in fit_model()) is added.

Usage

data_prep(
  comp = NULL,
  vars_for_grouping = NULL,
  bin_lab = "bin",
  count_var = "count",
  min_n = 1L,
  bin_width = NULL
)

Arguments

comp

A data frame with one row per observation (or per stratum and bin), with a column of counts, a column of bins and all vars_for_grouping.

vars_for_grouping

Character vector of the variables that define a stratum (e.g. c("Year", "Season", "Vessel")).

bin_lab

Name of the column holding the bins (length, age, etc.). Default "bin". The column is renamed to bin in the output.

count_var

Name of the column holding the counts. Default "count".

min_n

Integer. Minimum total count per grouping stratum. Strata with fewer than min_n total fish are dropped before fitting. Useful for removing sparse early years that would create all-zero design matrix columns and a singular Hessian. Default 1L (only empty strata dropped).

bin_width

Numeric. If supplied, bins are aggregated into wider bins of this width before summarising (e.g. bin_width = 20 merges 10cm bins into 20cm bins). Applied before min_n filtering. Default NULL (no aggregation).

Value

A grouped data frame with one row per stratum and bin, containing vars_for_grouping, bin, the count per bin (tot_by_bin) and the stratum total (n).

Details

Strata are defined by the unique combinations of vars_for_grouping. Any variable later used in fit_model() (fixed effects, nuisance random effects, continuous covariates, coordinates, time) must be included here, otherwise it is aggregated away.

See also

fit_model()

Examples

dat <- data_prep(
  ex_comp,
  vars_for_grouping = c("Year", "Season", "Vessel", "trip"),
  bin_lab = "length",
  count_var = "count"
)
head(dat)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 7
#> # Groups:   Year, Season, Vessel, trip [1]
#>   Year  Season Vessel  trip   bin tot_by_bin     n
#>   <fct> <fct>  <fct>  <int> <dbl>      <int> <int>
#> 1 2015  summer V1         1    10          5    60
#> 2 2015  summer V1         1    20         15    60
#> 3 2015  summer V1         1    30         21    60
#> 4 2015  summer V1         1    40         15    60
#> 5 2015  summer V1         1    50          2    60
#> 6 2015  summer V1         1    60          2    60

# merge 10 cm bins into 20 cm bins
head(data_prep(ex_comp, c("Year", "Season", "Vessel", "trip"), "length", "count",
               bin_width = 20))
#> # A tibble: 6 × 7
#> # Groups:   Year, Season, Vessel, trip [2]
#>   Year  Season Vessel  trip   bin tot_by_bin     n
#>   <fct> <fct>  <fct>  <int> <dbl>      <int> <int>
#> 1 2015  summer V1         1     0          5    60
#> 2 2015  summer V1         1    20         36    60
#> 3 2015  summer V1         1    40         17    60
#> 4 2015  summer V1         1    60          2    60
#> 5 2015  summer V1         2     0         21    60
#> 6 2015  summer V1         2    20         33    60
